about: Desk space to camera pixels: pixel ~ desk_to_pixel @ [x, y, z, 1], desk mm, z the height above the desk. It holds for frames of frame_size only, from a camera that has not moved. Fitted by calibration/, the camera page, to the three 40 mm cubes in camera-frame.png, standing where camera-points.json says: true_to_pixel is the camera alone, in true mm (the cubes' 40 mm its ruler), turned and shifted along the arm's x and y; desk_to_true takes the arm's x, y to true mm: the board's mirror and a stretch, the arm's measure against the camera's. Together they put the arm's points on the cubes the camera saw, exactly; desk_to_pixel is the two together. `refined`, if there, says the camera was fitted again, all of it, to the pictures of the points in camera-refine-points.json, and the arm laid on them all, least squares; `cubes_alone` keeps the two matrices as the cubes alone gave them. `lens` is the camera it was calibrated with, as it calls itself, and the focus it was held at (focus_absolute): the live view holds that camera at it, since focusing moves the picture.
